title: Community Safety and Well-Being Advisory Committee - June 18, 2024
meeting_location: Colonel By Room, 110 Laurier Avenue West, and by electronic participation

agenda_items.title: Notices and meeting information for meeting participants and the public
agenda_items.description:
Members of Committee and Council, City staff, media and the general public may join the meeting with this link:
Zoom webinar ID: 845 4075 0221
Those who require a telephone number to call into the Zoom meeting may contact the committee coordinator.
Notices and meeting information are attached to the agenda and minutes, including: availability of simultaneous interpretation and accessibility accommodations; personal information disclaimer for correspondents and public speakers; notices regarding minutes; and remote participation details.
Accessible formats and communication supports are available, upon request.
The deadline to register to speak by phone or email, or submit written comments or visual presentations is 2 pm on the day of the meeting.

agenda_items.title: Declarations of Interest
agenda_items.minutes: No Declarations of Interest were filed.

sub_agendas_items.title: Election of Chair and Vice-Chair
sub_agendas_items.minutes:
Melinda Aston, Coordinator, Standing Committee, provided an overview of the election process.
Following nominations for the position of Chair, the sole nominee, Tom D'Amico, was acclaimed to the position of Chair for a term of one year starting at the next Committee meeting. 
Following nominations for the position of Vice-Chair, the sole nominee, Claire Kendall, was acclaimed to the position of Vice-Chair for a term of one year starting at the next Committee meeting.

sub_agendas_items.title: Update on Priorities for the Community Safety and Well-Being Advisory Committee – Gender-Based Violence and Mental Well-Being
sub_agendas_items.minutes:
Sarah Taylor, Director, Community Safety, Well-Being, Policy and Analytics, and Sawsan Al-Refaei, Manager, Strategic Projects, as well as Keri Lewis (Interval House) and Candice Shaw (Ottawa Rape Crisis Centre), provided a presentation and answered questions from the Committee.  A copy of the slide presentation is filed with the Office of the City Clerk.
Calla Barnett spoke before the Committee and provided comments on the item.
At the conclusion of discussions, the Committee received the update:

motions.motion_text:
Recommendation
That the Community Safety and Well-Being Advisory Committee receive the update for information.

sub_agendas_items.title: Update on the transition of Crime Prevention Ottawa
sub_agendas_items.minutes:
Sarah Taylor, Director, Community Safety, Well-Being, Policy and Analytics, Sarah Mullen, Program Manager, Social Development, and Ahmad Luqman, Business Consultant, Crime Prevention, provided a presentation and answered questions from the Committee.  A copy of the slide presentation is filed with the Office of the City Clerk.
Robin Browne, and Louise Lapointe also spoke before the Committee and provided comments on the item.
At the conclusion of discussions, the Committee received the update:

motions.motion_text:
Recommendation
That the Community Safety and Well-Being Advisory Committee receive the update for information.

agenda_items.title: Notices of Motions (For Consideration at Subsequent Meeting)
agenda_items.minutes: There were no Notices of Motion.
